purpose: Single source of truth for the honesty/confidence label shown as a tooltip on every WR/PF/Sharpe cell across /audit and the Investment Hub. Answers the user's question for any metric: 'Is it institutional grade? Is it promising but not statistically valid yet? Or is it unverified / no-edge / contaminated?' Thresholds inherit from docs/PERFORMANCE_CHARTER.md (canonical); this file adds the VALIDITY gates that decide whether a number may be trusted at all.
decisive_definition: A pick is DECISIVE only if it has a hard-resolved outcome: TP hit (WIN) or SL hit (LOSS). Picks resolved by max-hold/expiry-by-pnl-sign are SOFT-resolved and counted separately; >25% soft-resolution caps a cohort at 'promising_not_valid'. OPEN/active picks are never counted in WR/PF.

tiers.label: Institutional-grade
tiers.tooltip_short: A quant fund would trust this. PF≥2.0, WR≥55%, MaxDD≤10%, n≥200 hard-resolved, OOS-confirmed, no single-source >60%.
tiers.tooltip_full: Charter Tier 1 (Renaissance-grade). ALL of: Profit Factor ≥ 2.0; Win Rate ≥ 55%; MaxDD ≤ 10%; n ≥ 200 DECISIVE (hard-resolved) picks; out-of-sample holdout PF ≥ 1.5 via WALK-FORWARD (no cherry-picked holdout period); no single source_system or symbol ≥ 60% of decisive picks; ZERO soft-resolution; staleness ≤ 30d (HARD gate); R:R-asymmetry sanity passed (WR is not an artifact of extreme TP/SL payoff skew); deduped; anomaly-excluded; Sharpe ≥ 1.2. Eligible for sized-up live capital.

tiers.label: Production-viable
tiers.tooltip_short: Real, sized-up-able edge. PF≥1.5, WR≥50%, MaxDD≤20%, n≥100 hard-resolved, no fatal concentration.
tiers.tooltip_full: Charter Tier 2 (sized-up live-capital floor). ALL of: PF ≥ 1.5; WR ≥ 50%; MaxDD ≤ 20%; n ≥ 100 DECISIVE picks; no single source/symbol ≥ 60%; ≤25% soft-resolved; deduped; anomaly-excluded; Sharpe ≥ 0.8. Trustworthy for real capital at conservative size; not yet OOS-proven enough for Tier 1.

tiers.label: Promising — not statistically valid yet
tiers.tooltip_short: Positive measured edge, but fails a validity gate (small n, single-source, stale, no OOS, or soft-resolution). PAPER-ONLY — do not size up.
tiers.tooltip_full: A POSITIVE, honestly-measured result (PF ≥ 1.2 on hard-resolved decisive picks) that fails ONE OR MORE statistical-validity gates: n < 100 decisive; a single source/symbol ≥ 60% of decisive picks; data is stale (newest pick > 30 days old); out-of-sample not yet confirmed; or > 25% of the 'wins' are soft-resolved (max-hold/expiry-by-sign rather than a TP hit). Genuinely interesting, paper-trade / forward-test only. The honest answer to 'is this real edge?' is 'maybe — not enough evidence yet.'
gates_required: at least one validity gate FAILED

current_live_examples.why_not_valid: n<100, crypto-concentrated, STALE (newest 2026-02-16), ~40% of wins soft-resolved (max-hold). Needs a fresh forward-test before any audit ingestion.

tiers.label: Candidate — paper-trade candidate (DSR-corrected, n<100)
tiers.tooltip_short: DSR≥0.95 after multiple-testing correction (Lopez de Prado AFML eq 14.5) but n<100. PAPER-ONLY — do not size up. The next era of honest-measurement candidates.
tiers.tooltip_full: A STRICTER sub-class of `promising_not_valid` for strategies that pass the Deflated Sharpe Ratio multiple-testing correction at >=0.95 confidence. The DSR explicitly accounts for the number of strategies tested and rejects single-strategy Sharpe values that would be expected to appear by chance when many strategies are tried. The remaining barrier is sample size (n<100 hard-resolved) — at higher n the strategy either becomes production_viable or regresses. PAPER-ONLY — wire to forward-paper-test, do NOT size up. The 2026-06-12 anti_overfit_audit.json cohort has 4 strategies at this tier; prediction_market_consensus (n=215) is the only one with n>=100 and is a tier-2 candidate pending the kill-list reconciliation.
gates_required: n_decisive<100 OR (n_decisive>=100 AND strategy is on HARD_KILL_STRATEGIES for a contradictory intrabar cohort)

current_live_examples.why_paper_only: n<100; PF 14.7 is high but only 36 trades; need n->100 to confirm
n<100; 100% WR with n=24 is suspicious; need forward-paper-test
n<100; 1h timeframe is overfit-bait; need 24h cross-validation

n>=100 but on HARD_KILL_STRATEGIES (P0B 2026-06-12, WR 26% intrabar) for a contradictory intrabar cohort. WALK-FORWARD REFUTES 2026-06-13: survival_rate=27.9% (gate >=60%), mean_oos_wr=47.4% (gate >=50%), is_pf=55.5 (massive overfit). DSR=0.998 in anti_overfit_audit was a single-window cohort, NOT rolling-walk-forward. Operator decision required: confirm kill or re-test with longer history.

tiers.label: Unverified — no outcome resolution
tiers.tooltip_short: Picks exist but were never tracked to a win/loss. WR/PF CANNOT be stated. Any displayed performance is fabricated or synthetic.
tiers.tooltip_full: The pick table has NO resolved-outcome column (no status/exit_price/pnl/return), OR the only 'performance' available comes from pre-aggregated summary tables that contain synthetic/sentinel values. A win rate or profit factor for this cohort cannot be honestly computed and must NOT be displayed as if real. This is the dominant state of the Investment Hub feeds. Fix = wire an outcome resolver (pattern: alpha_engine/outcome_resolver.py) before any edge claim.
gates_required: zero decisive (hard or soft) outcomes available

current_live_examples.why: no outcome columns; *_backtest_trades companion tables are empty
score/rating only, no NAV-based return tracking

tiers.label: No edge / negative
tiers.tooltip_short: Honestly measured and losing. PF<1.2 or WR<45% on hard-resolved decisive picks.
tiers.tooltip_full: A fully-resolved cohort (n ≥ 30 decisive) that does not make money: PF < 1.2 OR WR < 45% OR MaxDD > 25%. The measurement is trustworthy; the strategy is not. Candidate for the mutation-before-kill protocol (PERFORMANCE_CHARTER.md §8), not for capital.

tiers.label: Disputed / contaminated
tiers.tooltip_short: Headline looks great but contradicts the canonical view due to leakage: dup groups, EXPIRED→WON relabels, single-source, outlier PF, or fabricated/sentinel values.
tiers.tooltip_full: A high headline WR/PF that does NOT reconcile with the policy-clean canonical view (pf_registry.json::by_asset_class_policy_clean_net). Cause is a known leakage pattern: duplicate signal-timestamp groups, EXPIRED→WON mislabels, >60% single-source concentration, a mathematically-absurd PF (>10, usually a few corrupt pnl rows), soft-resolution inflation, or literal fabricated values (decimal-column-max sentinels). Treat the number as FALSE until independently re-derived. Display with a DISPUTED banner.
gates_required: headline metric contradicts canonical policy-clean view

tooltip_render_note: Pages should render the tooltip_short on hover over any WR/PF/Sharpe cell, color the cell border per `color`, and prefix the metric with `emoji`. The full definition + the decisive_definition belong in a glossary modal linked from each tooltip. NEVER display a WR/PF for an 'unverified_unresolved' cohort — show the label instead.

anti_gaming_gates.note: Added 2026-05-29 from peer review (the threshold gates above are necessary but not sufficient — these close the loopholes a dishonest reporter could still exploit).

rr_asymmetry_ok.loophole: Tight TP + wide SL manufactures a high WR via random-walk TP hits; PF>2 is trivial with 10:1 payoff asymmetry on coin-flip signals. A fixed 'R:R<0.5 AND WR>65%' trigger is gameable (sit at R:R=0.6 or WR=64% and slip through).
rr_asymmetry_ok.gate: EXPECTANCY GATE (replaces the fixed trigger). For each cohort compute median R:R = |TP-entry|/|SL-entry| and the break-even win rate BE = 1/(1 + R:R). A no-edge random strategy lands AT the break-even line for its own R:R, so: bar from blue/green unless the Wilson lower-bound of observed WR EXCEEDS BE by a statistically significant margin (i.e. expectancy WR*TP - (1-WR)*SL > 0 with the WR CI lower bound, not the point estimate). This is un-gameable — moving TP/SL shifts BE with you. Examples: R:R=0.5 -> BE 66.7%; R:R=0.6 -> BE 62.5%; R:R=1.0 -> BE 50%; R:R=2.0 -> BE 33.3%. Also require conditional WR by holding-period bucket so a 'TP-by-noise' cohort is visible.
rr_asymmetry_ok.source: nvidia/kimi-k2.6 (raised loophole) + fireworks/kimi-k2p5 (derived BE=1/(1+R:R) expectancy fix), round-2 peer review

loss_tail_check.loophole: Many small soft-resolved wins + a few large hard-resolved losses can show high WR while bleeding money; median R:R misses the fat loss tail.
loss_tail_check.gate: PF (not WR) is the binding metric for blue/green; additionally report the largest single loss and max consecutive loss so an asymmetric loss tail is visible even when WR looks good.

oos_walkforward_not_cherrypicked.loophole: 'OOS holdout PF>=1.5' is itself gameable: cherry-pick the holdout period, leak future data, or mislabel in-sample as OOS.
oos_walkforward_not_cherrypicked.gate: OOS must be a fixed walk-forward split declared BEFORE the run (anchored or rolling), not a period chosen after seeing results. No parameter tuning on the holdout. Record the split spec alongside the metric so it is independently reproducible.

soft_resolution_clustering_watch.loophole: With a 25% soft cap on blue, cohorts can cluster just below 25% to maximize WR inflation.
soft_resolution_clustering_watch.gate: Apply the soft-share to ATTEMPTED resolutions (not just closed). Monitor the soft-share distribution for pile-up at 24-25%; tighten over time as data quality improves.

consensus.Q1_n200_floor: KEEP n>=200 for Tier-1 — a hard count is harder to game than a vague 'stricter OOS' (3/3).
consensus.Q2_soft_cap: ZERO soft-resolution for green; 25% cap only for blue, applied to attempted resolutions (3/3). Draft updated accordingly.
consensus.Q3_unverified_vs_disputed: TWO separate tiers — absence-of-evidence (omission) vs evidence-of-tampering (commission) need different audit responses (3/3).
consensus.Q4_staleness: HARD gate for green; soft warning acceptable for blue (3/3; Hermes wanted hard for both).
consensus.biggest_loophole: TP/SL placement gaming (manufactured WR via payoff asymmetry) + non-verifiable OOS construction — both now addressed by anti_gaming_gates above.

round_2.key_improvement: fireworks/kimi derived BE=1/(1+R:R): the fixed 'R:R<0.5 AND WR>65%' trigger was replaced with an expectancy gate (require Wilson-lower-bound WR > break-even WR). groq added the loss-tail/PF-binding gate. together flagged staleness cherry-picking (already a hard gate for green).
